bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "SELECT current_database(); SELECT table_schema,table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('\''posting_topics'\'','\''gaybbs_feature_release_gates'\'') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name;"'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('\''topic_id'\'',topic_id,'\''thread'\'',message_thread_id,'\''title'\'',title,'\''verified'\'',verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL,'\''enabled'\'',enabled))::text,'\''[]'\'') FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='\''video_sale'\'' AND chat_id=-1002373696859;"'
